source_of_truth.principle: Design decisions must follow the existing Aurora Blue product UI unless the owner explicitly approves a redesign.

theme_and_archetype.archetype: Minimal, therapeutic, focused, high-trust web app
theme_and_archetype.vibe: Quiet digital therapy room: deep navy, soft cyan light, glass layers, calm motion, low visual noise.
theme_and_archetype.rationale: Myra needs to feel private, steady, and technically reliable. The interface should support deep conversation without turning into a dashboard or marketing page.

background.name: Primary Dark
background.usage: Page shell, safe areas, dark app frame.

primary.name: Deep Navy
primary.usage: Primary brand surfaces and strong actions.

primary_soft.name: Soft Navy
primary_soft.usage: Button gradients and secondary dark surfaces.

accent.name: Aurora Cyan
accent.usage: Focus accents, dividers, glows, status light.

accent_deep.name: Action Blue
accent_deep.usage: Primary action gradient start and active call controls.

accent_soft.name: Ice Blue
accent_soft.usage: Text on dark badges, subtle highlights.

danger.name: Calm Danger
danger.usage: Stop, destructive, and urgent states without aggressive red.

display.usage: Main product names and strong screen titles.

body.usage: All readable app text, chat, forms, explanations.

typography.rule: Keep type calm and legible. Do not use viewport-scaled text. Letter spacing must never be negative.

layout_rules.first_screen: Show the working app surface first. Do not replace app screens with marketing hero pages.
layout_rules.cards: Use cards for forms, repeated items, modals, and framed tools only. Avoid nested cards.
layout_rules.radius: Default card radius should stay around 8-16px. Pill radius only for badges and small utility actions.
layout_rules.spacing: Dense enough for operational use, calm enough for mental-health reading. Avoid cramped chat bubbles.
layout_rules.mobile: All primary flows must fit narrow mobile widths without overlap, clipped controls, or hidden primary actions.

component_rules.content_background: Use ContentBackground for app screens that need the Aurora environment. Do not introduce unrelated beige, purple, or one-hue gradient systems.
component_rules.top_bar: Keep TopBar compact, dark, and functional. Menu/back controls must remain obvious and touch-friendly.
component_rules.login: Login should feel premium, private, and simple: logo, short product description, form, support contact.
component_rules.chat: Conversation is the primary product surface. Preserve readable message widths, timestamps, avatar grounding, TXT export, and a stable bottom input bar.
component_rules.live: Live should stay centered and low-noise: avatar, status, one large microphone/stop control, clear memory notice, no transcript persistence unless explicitly redesigned.
component_rules.quiz: Quiz screens should keep section context, large tap targets, and clear progress. Decorative sheen layers must not block interaction.

accessibility_and_ux.contrast: Text on glass surfaces must remain readable against the dark gradient.
accessibility_and_ux.touch_targets: Primary controls should be at least 44x44px.
accessibility_and_ux.motion: Motion should communicate state, not decorate. Live pulse is acceptable; avoid competing animations.
accessibility_and_ux.copy: Keep interface text short, direct, and Hungarian-first.
accessibility_and_ux.warnings: Medical/therapeutic disclaimers must remain visible where chat or live guidance appears.

technical_rules.web_shadows: Use theme shadow tokens. On web they must resolve to boxShadow, not deprecated React Native shadow props.
technical_rules.pointer_events: Decorative overlay layers must use style.pointerEvents = 'none', not the deprecated pointerEvents prop.
technical_rules.test_ids: Important interactive elements should keep stable testID values in kebab-case.
technical_rules.assets: Use local assets from frontend/assets/images where possible. Do not depend on remote image URLs for core UI identity.

do_not_do: Do not rewrite or soften the Myra prompt while doing design work.
Do not turn Myra into a generic SaaS dashboard.
Do not introduce a new color palette without explicit approval.
Do not add decorative visual noise that slows the app or distracts from conversation.
Do not hide admin or safety controls behind novelty UI.
